question: The given extract is
solution:
The correct answer is** 'a narrative'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is written from the first-person point of view, recounting the personal experiences of the narrator. 
 
• It describes a series of events and observations made by the narrator on their way to and eventual arrival at a peculiar house.
 
• The focus is on the detailed description of the surroundings, the atmosphere, and interactions with a stranger, all of which are characteristic elements of a narrative.
 
• There is an evident storytelling style in the way the narrator describes their journey and emotions, making the passage engaging and vivid.
 
• The progression of events, along with the internal thoughts and feelings of the narrator, helps to develop a storyline typical of narrative writing.
 
• The use of descriptive language and attention to specific details (such as the open windows, the mist, and the inviting smell of food) enhances the narrative quality of the extract.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A travelogue: Typically focuses on discussing travel experiences, places visited, and observations about those places.
 
• A report: An account based on factual information, usually formal and objective.
 
• A biography: A detailed description or account of someone's life, focusing on their experiences and significance.
